item.title: Grimoire ~Ingyaku no Madousho ni Oboreru Yuri Shimai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Magical Girl
  • 発売日: 2010-06-25
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: グリモワール～淫虐の魔道書に溺れる百合姉妹～
  • 英語名: Grimoire Ingyaku no Madousho ni Oboreru Yuri Shimai

あらすじ

One day Asami witnessed a moment of lesbian kissing between the target of her yearning affections, Miyuki, and her dorm mate and friend, Kyoko.

Shocked and jealous, Asami felt her chest would burst, when a strange “voice” inside her own head spoke to her.

“Shall I grant your heart’s desire?”

item.title: Ryoujoku Shinpan Mahou Shoujo Sumire & Daisy ~Torawareta Seishoujo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Magical Girl
  • 発売日: 2008-10-04
  • スコア: 6.01/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 凌辱審判 魔法少女すみれ＆デイジー ～囚われた聖少女～
  • 英語名: Ryoujoku Shinpan Mahou Shoujo Sumire & Daisy Torawareta Seishoujo

别名

  • Disgrace Judgement Magical Young Girl Sumire & Daisy

あらすじ

The magical girls, Sumire and Daisy belonged to church, protecting the world peace.

People called them “glorious young ladies” as the girls were so sincere, pure and beautiful.

Their duty this time was to rescue the young girl who was imprisoned by the crazed church members.
